meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 扫描项目里没用到的代码(变量、导入、类型、文件等),确认它们没被别处引用后,交给多个并行代理分批删除并提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建;入口、测试、配置文件等受保护内容不会删。
howto.when: 当你说“删除死代码”“清理”“remove unused”等触发词,或把范围指向某个文件/目录/符号时。

say.text: 删掉这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 会先扫描验证,再分批删除并提交。

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 这个目录里的无用代码
say.note: 扫描范围会限制在该目录。

say.text: 找出未使用的参数,在名字前加下划线
say.note: 对应协议里的 PREFIX _ 处理。

howto.what_en: Scans for unused code (variables, imports, types, files), checks that nothing references them, then has parallel agents delete and commit in batches, then runs typecheck, tests, build. Entry points and test/config files are kept.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests like 'remove dead code', 'cleanup', 'remove unused', or when you scope the scan to a file, directory, or symbol.

say_en.text: Remove dead code from this project.
say_en.note: It scans and verifies, then deletes in parallel and commits.

say_en.text: Only clean up unused code in the src/utils directory.
say_en.note: The scan is scoped to that directory.

say_en.text: Find unused parameters and prefix them with an underscore.
say_en.note: This uses the PREFIX _ action from the protocol.
